stories.title: Chip stocks and oil fall after Democratic election sweep
stories.summary: Chip stocks and oil prices fell following a sweeping Democratic election win, Investing.com reported. The report does not give specific names or price levels. The drop points to investor concern about the political shift.
stories.whyItMatters: Chipmakers and oil are sensitive to policy risk. A change in political control can shift trade, tax, and energy rules that move these sectors.

stories.title: Australia's central bank warns public confidence in inflation fight is slipping
stories.summary: Australia's central bank said public confidence in its ability to control inflation is weakening, Investing.com reported. The warning signals the bank sees a risk to its inflation-fighting credibility.
stories.whyItMatters: Weaker public confidence can make inflation expectations harder to anchor. This raises the odds of further rate action.
whatToWatch: The central bank's next policy meeting and rate decision
Future readings on public inflation expectations
questions: What data or survey shows confidence is slipping?

stories.title: Sony's Q2 profit jumps 45% on movies and games, raises full-year forecast

stories.whyItMatters: Sony's entertainment and gaming strength shows consumer demand is holding up in these segments, a signal for media and tech investors.
